issues.competing_evidence: Schwope+99 low-state model gives 45 +/- 1 MG at kT=2 keV; Schwope+02_RBS supports a high-state 32 MG spot and a 33.7 MG alternative fit to the persistent hump; Campbell+08 abstract reports 34.0 MG, kT=3.5 keV and log Lambda=4.1 from two IR modeling approaches.
issues.why_it_matters: Field component, accretion state and model degeneracy affect comparisons between photospheric WD fields and local accretion-region fields across magnetic CVs.
issues.needed_action: Obtain Campbell et al. (2008) full article and inspect methods, tables, phase/state, fit bounds and caveats; decide whether its 34.0 MG result is one component or a degenerate model family. Keep it abstract-only and do not average meanwhile.
issues.public_status: Awaiting access to the original source

J1503-2207 audit: Table lists X-band flux 29 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-14 percent circular polarization, Porb=2.2228 h, distance=392 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. Barrett+20 reports X-band Stokes I 6±6 μJy and custom S/N 7.3, but Ridder+23 treats the point as below 3σ. Its 2.3966 h and 441 pc values are consistent with the RX J0859 literature and Gaia DR2/EDR3 distances; the 3563±730 G inference remains conditional radio-plasma field, not WD surface field.
